align.zh-CN: 子元素的垂直对齐方式，可选 `top`、`middle` 或 `bottom`。
align.en-US: Vertical alignment of the children: `top`, `middle` or `bottom`.

className.en-US: Class name of the root element.

gutter.zh-CN: 栅格间隔，可以是像素值、响应式对象 `{ xs, sm, md, lg, xl, xxl }`，或 `[水平, 垂直]` 数组，未设置时为 `0`。
gutter.en-US: Grid gutter in pixels, a responsive object `{ xs, sm, md, lg, xl, xxl }`, or a `[horizontal, vertical]` pair. Defaults to `0`.

justify.zh-CN: 子元素的水平排列方式，可选 `start`、`end`、`center`、`space-around` 或 `space-between`，未设置时为 `start`。
justify.en-US: Horizontal arrangement of the children: `start`, `end`, `center`, `space-around` or `space-between`. Defaults to `start`.

className.en-US: Class name of the root element.

lg.zh-CN: 屏幕宽度 ≥992px 时生效的响应式栅格，可为栅格数或 `{ span, offset, order, push, pull }` 对象。
lg.en-US: Responsive grid for screens ≥992px, as a column count or a `{ span, offset, order, push, pull }` object.

md.zh-CN: 屏幕宽度 ≥768px 时生效的响应式栅格，可为栅格数或 `{ span, offset, order, push, pull }` 对象。
md.en-US: Responsive grid for screens ≥768px, as a column count or a `{ span, offset, order, push, pull }` object.

offset.zh-CN: 栅格起始侧（从左到右排版时为左侧）的间隔格数，间隔内不可以有栅格，未设置时为 `0`。
offset.en-US: Number of columns to offset from the start side. No column can sit inside the offset. Defaults to `0`.

pull.zh-CN: 栅格向起始侧（从左到右排版时为左侧）移动的格数，未设置时为 `0`。
pull.en-US: Number of columns to move toward the start side. Defaults to `0`.

push.zh-CN: 栅格向末尾侧（从左到右排版时为右侧）移动的格数，未设置时为 `0`。
push.en-US: Number of columns to move toward the end side. Defaults to `0`.

sm.zh-CN: 屏幕宽度 ≥576px 时生效的响应式栅格，可为栅格数或 `{ span, offset, order, push, pull }` 对象。
sm.en-US: Responsive grid for screens ≥576px, as a column count or a `{ span, offset, order, push, pull }` object.

span.zh-CN: 栅格占位格数，为 0 时相当于 `display: none`。
span.en-US: Number of columns the cell spans. 0 behaves like `display: none`.

xl.zh-CN: 屏幕宽度 ≥1200px 时生效的响应式栅格，可为栅格数或 `{ span, offset, order, push, pull }` 对象。
xl.en-US: Responsive grid for screens ≥1200px, as a column count or a `{ span, offset, order, push, pull }` object.

xs.zh-CN: 基础层响应式栅格，所有屏幕宽度都生效，可为栅格数或 `{ span, offset, order, push, pull }` 对象。
xs.en-US: Base-layer responsive grid. It applies at every screen width, as a column count or a `{ span, offset, order, push, pull }` object.

xxl.zh-CN: 屏幕宽度 ≥1600px 时生效的响应式栅格，可为栅格数或 `{ span, offset, order, push, pull }` 对象。
xxl.en-US: Responsive grid for screens ≥1600px, as a column count or a `{ span, offset, order, push, pull }` object.
